reason: Accendra sells home-delivered medical equipment, supplies and support to patients, providers and insurers. Ensign operates skilled nursing, rehabilitation and assisted living facilities through affiliates. The products and delivery differ: equipment and supplies shipped to the home versus facility-based residential care. The overlap is in the patient and payer base, since both serve patients and the healthcare payers behind them, in post-acute and home-based care. That is customer overlap without product overlap, so it is adjacent.
missing_evidence: Shown lines do not cover Ensign's payer mix or revenue model, nor Accendra's reimbursement and regulatory exposure.

primary_products.reason: No shown Ensign lines describe products sold.

primary_services.reason: Accendra supplies products, services and support for care at home. Ensign provides facility-based skilled nursing, therapy and assisted living. Both are healthcare services, but the offerings differ.

customer_segment.reason: Both serve patients needing ongoing care. Accendra also serves providers and insurers. Ensign's lines show only residents.

end_markets.reason: Home-based care versus post-acute and long-term care. They are adjacent healthcare settings.

business_model.reason: Accendra delivers equipment, supplies and support to the home. Ensign runs care locations through its affiliates.

revenue_model.reason: No shown lines on how either company earns revenue.

value_chain_position.reason: Not clearly evidenced on both sides in the shown lines.

specialization.reason: Not enough shown evidence to compare.

distribution_channels.reason: Target delivery channels are not shown in the lines.
